title: Zero-dimensional compactness: weak limits of integer multiplicity 0-currents
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and X_j (j ∈ ℕ), X ∈ D_0(U) with every X_j integer multiplicity, sup_j M_W(X_j) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U (CompactlyContainedOpen W U), and X_j ⇀ X weakly in U. Then X is an integer multiplicity current (the case n = 0 of Simon 3.11/8.2).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (Xj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U 0) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U 0), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Xj j)) → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (⨆ j, (Xj j).massOn W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Xj X → IsIntegerMultiplicity X
